column1: # License of each Android library in the release runtime classpath, read from its POM. A key is a
# group or group:module; group:module wins. scripts/notices.sh fails when a library has no key.
# Libraries with the same files are listed together, in the order of their first row, and the
# files (relative to this folder) are printed once after them.

column2: Apache-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later, used under Apache-2.0
